title: Real Yield on Idle Ethereum? Here's What I Made
description:
Over 6% monthly yield. Here's the live on-chain proof from the Uniswap ETH/USDC LP position I opened two weeks ago.

I walk through the exact position on Uniswap, pull the full deposit and fee history from Revert Finance, plot my range against the actual price action, and do the math live — $3.16 in fees over 15 days on $99.12 deposited. That annualizes to better than 6% per month on the earn side of the DeFi carry trade. The yield works the same whether you deploy $100 or $100,000, and this pool has $100M+ in TVL — I explain why that matters at 5:17.

If you followed along with the original tutorial and opened your own position, drop your 15-day fee number below. I want to see real results from real people.

What you'll learn:
* The exact range I set (1,900 to 2,200) and why it captured almost all of the price action
* How to pull the complete deposit and fee history from Revert Finance
* Why I draw my range as a rectangle on TradingView to audit performance
* The one price excursion that broke my range and what caused it
* The simple math for annualizing LP yield from any time window
* How to collect fees without closing your position on Uniswap
* Why fees come back split across the paired tokens
* What position composition tells you about where price sits in your range
* Why the yield percentage is identical at $100 or $100,000
* How deep TVL pools absorb large positions without slippage problems

Pull up your own LP position right now. Double the fees. Divide by your deposit. Post the number below.

How to Provide Liquidity on Uniswap (the full tutorial this references): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JEnjVPDCnOE

asr.full_text: 15 days ago, I recorded a video teaching you everything you need to know to provide liquidity on Uniswap. And at the end of that video, I walked through the actual steps and opened a real live position. Tonight, I just checked the numbers, and I'm pretty pleased with the results. Let's go ahead and take a look. All right. So this is Uniswap and this is where I created the liquidity position 15 days ago, so let's go ahead and click into the position. You will remember I set up my price range for 1900 to 2200 on the range, and I deposited about 1 dollars in capital. If you remember when I created this position on Uniswap, Uniswap created an nft, it minted an nft and sent that to my wallet. So that's my proof of ownership, so to speak with the liquidity position because that NFT is sitting in my wallet right now. I'm going to go ahead and look at this position on a different protocol called revert finance so this is revert finance and after i connect my wallet the protocol can see that same liquidity position in my wallet it reads the nft and it sees the position and this will give me some more details about the position in particular i want to take a look at the logs so this will give you the entire history of the position and you can see I Deposited this liquidity position on March 23rd at 9 15 p.m And you can see the amount of capital that I deployed into the position about $99 into the liquidity pool now another thing I like to do with my liquidity positions I like to track the position on the chart so I drew this rectangle this starts back on March 23rd and it reflects the top and the bottom of my range so I can see with this chart and this rectangle I can see exactly how my range performed. Remember this is like fishing. We want to cast our net and set up our range where we think it's going to capture the future price action. So what we see here is the range did a pretty good job. of the price action over the last 15 days except for this little excursion here when we got the news last night about the ceasefire in Iran so the market got a little excited price poked up above the top of my range and now it's pulling back a little bit so overall I'm happy with this range it did its job it captured a lot of fish, captured a lot of price action in the net here, and that's what we want to do as a liquidity provider. Now, the next thing I want to do is calculate my yield. Like I said, the position has been open for 15 days, almost exactly. It's about 9.27 PM as I record this so it's been exactly 15 days and about 13 minutes so I'm going to go ahead and just double the fees you can see here I've earned three dollars and sixteen cents in 15 days that is roughly half of a month so I'll just double that so that'll be six dollars and thirty two cents and then i'm gonna divide by the capital that I deposited bust out my calculator here so three dollars and sixteen cents multiply that by two just to have an estimate of what we could expect over the course of a full month and then I will divide that by the $99 and 12 cents that I Deposited into the position So this is going to tell me my monthly yield and there you can see it was better than 6% Per month so far even though I missed some of the price action The range did a pretty good job. And we're on track to earn more than six percent in just one single month. OK, so the last thing now is I'm just going to go ahead and collect these fees. I'll go to Uniswap and just hit the button. I will collect this in the form of ETH and USDC. It's about 50 50 and signed the transaction. And now the fees are collected. So that $3.16 worth of ETH and USDC, that goes directly to my wallet. You can see the position is still in place. Right now the price is dipping back down into the range. So you can see the position has a little bit of wrapped ETH from the current price up to the top of the range and the rest of it is USDC. You can see that here on Uniswap. About 8.3% ETH and 91.6% USDC in the position. So it's still there, still generating fees and we're on track to make more than 6% per month on the capital that we deployed into this position. So, there it is. 15 days real money, real fees and I am on track to earn more than 6% in just one month. The yield percentage is the same regardless of how much you deposit. I did a hundred dollars but i could have deposited a hundred thousand dollars and the math works out the exact same way this particular pool has more than a hundred million dollars in tvl there's plenty of room for big positions my little hundred dollar position was only meant to prove the concept and that's exactly what it did if you try this out yourself please let me know in the comments and tell me what you ended up earning. If you haven't started yet I'll put a link to the full tutorial video in the description below and you can try it out. That's it for now, thanks for watching!
